svg.title: Each turn: image or text?
svg.desc: Your agent supplies task states. Keep images still needed; replace older images with text only when all checks pass. Check and send a request copy; restore images when later tasks need them.
svg.text: Each turn: image or text?
1 · Your agent records each image
Save originals and the full conversation.
Register each copy; record its URL hash.
2 · Your agent supplies task states
Current, pending, uncertain, required?
Active, retrieved, compare, quality,
relation or action? → KEEP IMAGE.
3 · Check older images you can replace
Finished / invalidated and confident?
Source, version, stage and results match?
Your agent confirms results are enough?
ALL yes → TEXT; otherwise → IMAGE.
4 · ICM prepares; your agent sends
Check the plan; change a request copy.
Bad plan → stop and repair.
Your agent converts, checks and sends.
Later · Your agent needs images again
Compare: rebuild from the original chat.
Retrieve: check hash; attach and register
the original as a new image to keep.
Re-evaluate when tasks or state change.
Original conversation and files stay intact.
